title: Simply Piano Practice Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=simplypiano:session
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(song_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Simply Piano practice events land each day and how many distinct song name values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Simply Piano practice records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct song name values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much Simply Piano practice activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
